description: This file defines the UpdateManagerInterface interface in the Drupal update module, including constants for update statuses and method signatures for managing project update data.

classes.name: UpdateManagerInterface
classes.description: Interface for managing project update information in Drupal.

methods.name: getProjects
methods.description: Fetches an array of installed projects with detailed info.

methods.name: fetchDataBatch
methods.description: Processes a batch step for fetching update data.

methods.name: refreshUpdateData
methods.description: Clears existing update data and triggers re-fetching.

methods.name: projectStorage
methods.description: Retrieves or clears stored update project data.
